nodes.name: FED_CMS_NADAC
nodes.title: NADAC — National Average Drug Acquisition Cost
nodes.desc: The true acquisition-cost benchmark: what pharmacies actually pay per unit, by NDC. Lets Ripple compare Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement and negotiated prices against real cost — the markup/overpayment story. Carries clean NDC, unlike Part D Spending. Cleanest of the three. Direct CSV per week/year, e.g. https://download.medicaid.gov/data/nadac-national-average-drug-acquisition-cost-MM-DD-YYYY.csv, or pull the whole year via datastore: GET https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/{distributionId}/0?limit=N&offset=N (distribution id b3b205f4-... for 2024). Columns: ndc, ndc_description, nadac_per_unit, pricing_unit, effective_date, classification_for_rate_setting (brand/generic), otc, pharmacy_type_indicator, corresponding_generic_drug_nadac_per_unit, as_of_date. NDC is the steel join key to FDA NDC, Part D, RxNorm. One dataset per calendar year — loop years for full history. Datast

nodes.name: INTL_IPC_FOOD_INSECURITY_GLOBAL
nodes.title: IPC Global Acute Food Insecurity Country Data
nodes.desc: This IS the famine angle. Quantifies catastrophic food insecurity (Phase 5/Famine) and emergency (Phase 4) populations for Sudan and Darfur down to the analysis-area level — the data behind the 'famine confirmed in El Fasher/Kadugli' headlines, with official projections. Direct stable HDX download URLs (e.g. .../download/ipc_global_national_long_latest.csv) — no HDX login or API key needed; curl with a normal User-Agent works (the human-facing dataset PAGE 403s automated fetchers, but the CKAN resource download URLs are open). Choose granularity: national, level1 (admin1 — gives Darfur states), or area (IPC analysis units incl. El Fasher town, IDP camps). 'long' = tidy one-row-per-phase (recommended for Snowflake); 'wide' pivots phases to columns. Country code is ISO3 in the 'Country' column. Phase 5 = Famine — Sudan latest shows 134,808 (current) projected to 199,713. Percentage column

nodes.name: INTL_WB_IDS

nodes.desc: THE canonical source for developing-world sovereign/external debt — debt stocks, debt service, and a unique creditor-by-creditor (bilateral/multilateral/private) breakdown showing who each country owes. Directly answers 'global debt crisis' for the countries actually in crisis. USE THE BULK CSV, not the API, for the full panel. The Data API v2 path is /v2/sources/6/country/{ISO3}/series/{SERIES}/time/all?format=json and it explodes on the Counterpart-Area dimension — a single Ghana+DT.DOD.DECT.CD query returned 19,152 rows (counterpart x time) and ~6,384 pages. For a clean country panel filter Counterpart-Area=WLD (all creditors). Series codes are WDI-style (e.g. DT.DOD.DECT.CD = total external debt stocks; DT.TDS.DECT.CD = total debt service). Only low- and middle-income countries are covered (no high-income/G7 debtors). Years run 1970-2032; 2025+ are projection/null placeholders — drop
